# Device Inventory

The current device inventory is maintained privately. Public documentation does
not list installed hardware, asset identifiers, rack positions or wiring.

Keep device identities, hardware history, locations and maintenance details in
private asset records. See [Naming Conventions](naming-conventions.md) for the
naming pattern and [Fairy Site](../sites/fairy/) for related documentation.
